title: Smash Pumpkins
description: This mod makes it so carved pumpkins have durability.
body:
# Smash Pumpkins
### A awesome mod


This Project was created to solve a problem. 

_Carved pumpkins_. Wether its a prank or not there just annoying. So i made it so all carved pumpkins on your head have 55 durability or a peice or leather armor. :) - JEDIZUKE
